article.title: Die Linke score stunning election victory in Berlin
article.author: Editor
article.content: GERMANY’S Left party (DL) has scored a stunning victory in Berlin, winning a state election for the first time on a campaign to nationalise housing owned by corporate landlords and cap rents. The post Die Linke score stunning election victory in Berlin appeared first on MR Online .
